def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg= max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,)]
    # Three-cell, non-marker pattern identified as the straight contiguous colored run.
    # Here background is dominant and the remaining color cells encode the run, except marker dots.
    pts=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,3)]
    if len(pts)!=3: raise ValueError(pts)
    pts.sort()
    if len({r for r,c,v in pts})==1:
        orientation='h'; pts.sort(key=lambda t:t[1]); center=pts[1][1]; base=pts[1][0]; pattern=[v for r,c,v in pts]
    else:
        orientation='v'; pts.sort(key=lambda t:t[0]); center=pts[1][0]; base=pts[1][1]; pattern=[v for r,c,v in pts]
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
    for r,c in markers:
        if orientation=='h':
            for i,v in enumerate(pattern):
                cc=c+i-1
                if 0<=cc<len(g[0]): g[r][cc]=v
        else:
            for i,v in enumerate(pattern):
                rr=r+i-1
                if 0<=rr<len(g): g[rr][c]=v
    return g

    if len(pts)!=3: raise ValueError(pts)
    if len({r for r,c,v in pts})==1:
        pts.sort(key=lambda t:t[1]); pattern=[v for r,c,v in pts]; horizontal=True
    else:
        pts.sort(key=lambda t:t[0]); pattern=[v for r,c,v in pts]; horizontal=False
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
    for r,c in marks:
        for i,v in enumerate(pattern):
            rr,cc=(r,c+i-1) if horizontal else (r+i-1,c)

src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row),key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    occupied={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg}
    candidates=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w-2):
            cells=[(r,c+i) for i in range(3)]
            if all(p in occupied for p in cells): candidates.append((True,cells))
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w):
            cells=[(r+i,c) for i in range(3)]
            if all(p in occupied for p in cells): candidates.append((False,cells))

    horizontal,cells=candidates[0]
    pattern=[grid[r][c] for r,c in cells]

    marker=next(grid[r][c] for r,c in occupied-seeds)
    marks=[(r,c) for r,c in occupied-seeds if grid[r][c]==marker]

        for i,v in enumerate(pattern):
            rr,cc=(r,c+i-1) if horizontal else (r+i-1,c)
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: g[rr][cc]=v
